decision_rule: Mean paired learned-model improvement, averaged equally over the three data sizes, must be at least 0.05 and strictly positive for every initialization seed.
checkpoint_selection: Final step only; no development or final-set selection.
primary_interpretation: Conditional evidence to retain for independent replication, not confirmatory population inference.
failure_rule: Retain every attempt. Nonfinite or failed runs invalidate a complete-design verdict until an explicitly documented new experiment; never silently omit or replace them.
training_design: Nested subsets, equal numbers from each of four chain-depth strata; shared pool and matched batch draws across objectives and architectures.
curriculum: Four equal step stages enabling training depths 1, then 1-2, then 1-3, then 1-4.
limitations: Same exact additive unit-grid task algebra as v1
One training pool and one evaluation seed
Initialization seeds are the only replication axis
Shared sign-factorized output head remains a structural prior
Geometry objective supplies extra coordinate supervision
Cross-architecture parameters and compute are not matched
Composition exclusions are syntactic, not algebraically disjoint
Local frozen protocol, not external preregistration
Not a test of Sophontic, Bohm, AGI, or alignment
